blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) has condemned the killing of RBN News Television broadcaster Adrian “Golden Boy” Loterte, who was shot by unidentified gunmen on Monday afternoon. “We are exerting all efforts. We have introduced all interventions to protect our media practitioners, especially from crimes like this,” PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Rae Co said in a press briefing on Tuesday. “We are in constant coordination and cooperation with the Presidential Task Force on Media Security (PTFOMS),” he added. Reports said the incident occurred at the broadcaster’s bakery in Barangay San Roque, Daraga, Albay, at 4:10 p.m. on Monday. […]...
